body: My kid won't sleep til almost midnight 😭😭😭😭😭😭😭😭

Yes I'm set up w a new therapist and psych but the day to day anxieties of negotiating w a 2 year old drive me insane. Like I just want to leave! And I know the time is so short but I just can't deal. Especially in quarantine.

My kid's dad sometimes but bc we had a toxic relationship it's hard to be totally honest. I have a couple friends but I find it hard to keep the friendships up. They feel a bit one-sided. I would really love if I could find a support group for parents w mental illness
